_meta.note: Ascension variants are stored in fields prefixed with the ascension level (e.g. a8_hp, a9_moves). HP typically scales at A8+, damage/buffs at A9+. Use base fields as defaults; override by field when the current ascension has a matching prefixed field. NOTE: Gremlin Merc is the one exception in this act — its attack damage scales at Ascension 8, so its override list is a8_moves.
missing: Slay_the_Spire_2:Toadpole — page documents the Thorns power but never states a starting Thorns count, and the enemy data module lists no StartsWith field for it; `powers` omitted. Toadpole only gains Thorns in combat via Spiken.

Slay_the_Spire_2:Gas_Bomb, Slay_the_Spire_2:Calcified_Cultist, Slay_the_Spire_2:Damp_Cultist — no standalone pages (404). Full stats taken from Slay_the_Spire_2:Living_Fog, Slay_the_Spire_2:Cultists and Module:Enemies/StS2_data/Underdocks.
Lagavulin Matriarch Slash2: data module scales damage at A9 but Block at A8 ({{Asc|8|14|2}}) — likely wiki typo; a9_moves uses 14/14, but the Block bump may start at A8.
Waterfall Giant Siphon: heal is '15 HP per player' verbatim (implies unspecified multiplayer scaling); no ascension variant documented.

powers: Ravenous 4 (5 at A9) — when an enemy dies, Corpse Slug immediately eats it, becoming Stunned and gaining that much Strength
Corpse Slug.pattern: Fixed cycle Whip Slap → Glomp → Goop; each Corpse Slug starts on a different move in the cycle.

moves: Bubble Burp — gains 7 Block and 1 Strength
a9_moves: Bubble Burp — gains 8 Block and 2 Strength
Seapunk.pattern: Fixed cycle Sea Kick → Spinning Kick → Bubble Burp, repeating.

Sludge Spinner.pattern: Always uses Oil Spray first. After that, randomly uses one of its three moves each turn, and cannot use the same move twice in a row.

moves: Spike Spit — 3 dmg × 3, removes 2 Thorns from self
a9_moves: Spike Spit — 4 dmg × 3, removes 2 Thorns from self
Toadpole.pattern: Fixed cycle Whirl → Spiken → Spike Spit, repeating. In the Toadpoles weak encounter (2 Toadpoles) the front Toadpole starts with Spiken instead.

Calcified Cultist.pattern: Always uses Incantation first, then Dark Strike every turn after. Ritual grants 2 Strength at end of turn, but it does not gain Strength on the turn it uses Incantation.

Damp Cultist.pattern: Always uses Incantation first, then Dark Strike every turn after. Ritual grants 5 Strength (6 at A9) at end of turn and does not trigger on the Incantation turn.

moves: Advanced Gas — 8 dmg + applies 1 Smoggy (limits you to 1 Skill per turn; does not stack)
a9_moves: Advanced Gas — 9 dmg + applies 1 Smoggy (limits you to 1 Skill per turn; does not stack)
Living Fog.pattern: Always uses Advanced Gas first, then alternates Bloat ↔ Super Gas Blast.

powers: Minion — abandons combat if its leader is gone
Suck 3 — whenever it deals unblocked attack damage, it gains 3 Strength
Fossil Stalker.pattern: Always opens with Latch. Every turn after, picks randomly with equal probability (1/3 each) among Latch, Tackle and Lash, with no restriction on repeating the same move. Suck triggers per unblocked hit.

powers: Surprise 1 — on death, summons 1 Fat Gremlin and 1 Sneaky Gremlin
Thievery 20 — steals the player's gold (the Fat Gremlin carries it off via Heist)
Gremlin Merc.pattern: Fixed cycle Gimme → Double Smash → Hehe, repeating.

moves: Flee — escapes combat with the stolen gold
Fat Gremlin.pattern: Does nothing the turn it is summoned, then uses Flee every turn after, escaping with the gold the Gremlin Merc stole. If it is killed before fleeing, the stolen gold is recovered.

Sneaky Gremlin.pattern: Does nothing the turn it is summoned, then uses Tackle every turn after.

moves: Haunt — shuffles 5 Dazed into your discard pile + applies 3 Weak
a9_moves: Haunt — shuffles 5 Dazed into your discard pile + applies 3 Weak
Haunted Ship.pattern: Always uses Haunt first. From the second turn onward, alternates Swipe ↔ Stomp, always starting with Swipe. Haunt is used only on turn 1.

powers: Artifact 1 — negates the first debuff applied to it
Punch Construct.pattern: Fixed cycle READY → Fast Punch → Strong Punch, repeating.

Sewer Clam.pattern: Always uses Jet first, then alternates Pressurize ↔ Jet every turn.

moves: Call for Backup — summons a new Two-Tailed Rat
a9_moves: Call for Backup — summons a new Two-Tailed Rat
Two-Tailed Rat.pattern: Each rat opens on a different move: one Scratch, one Disease Bite, one Screech. After that each rat randomly picks Scratch, Disease Bite or Screech, never using the same move twice in a row. After at least two turns a rat may instead use Call for Backup to summon a new rat; each rat can only summon once and the group can summon up to 3 times total (max 6 rats).

powers: Hardened Shell 20 — it cannot lose more than 20 HP each turn; the cap resets at the start of your turn AND at the start of its turn
Skulking Colony.pattern: Repeating 4-move cycle: Zoom → Zoom → Inertia → Piercing Stabs.

powers: Skittish 6 (7 at A8) — gains that much Block after the first attack played against it resolves
Phantasmal Gardener.pattern: All Gardeners cycle Bite → Lash → Flail → Enlarge in fixed order, each starting at a different point in the cycle.

powers: Shriek 70 (75 at A8) — when its HP drops to this threshold it becomes Stunned, then uses Terror
Terror Eel.pattern: Alternates Crash ↔ Thrash, starting with Crash. When its HP falls to the Shriek threshold (70, or 75 at A8) it becomes Stunned for a turn, then uses Terror to apply 99 Vulnerable, then resumes the Crash/Thrash alternation.

powers: Steam Eruption — When killed, deals X damage at the end of your next turn.
moves: Stomp — 15 dmg, applies 1 Weak, gains 3 Steam Eruption
Siphon — heals 15 HP per player, gains 3 Steam Eruption
Pressure Gun — 20 dmg (increases by 5 each use), gains 3 Steam Eruption
Pressure Up — 13 dmg, gains 3 Steam Eruption
About To Blow — becomes invulnerable, removes its Steam Eruption and prepares to explode
Explode — dmg equal to its stored Steam Eruption amount, then dies
a9_moves: Stomp — 16 dmg, applies 1 Weak, gains 3 Steam Eruption
Siphon — heals 15 HP per player, gains 3 Steam Eruption
Pressure Gun — 23 dmg (increases by 5 each use), gains 3 Steam Eruption
Pressure Up — 14 dmg, gains 3 Steam Eruption
About To Blow — becomes invulnerable, removes its Steam Eruption and prepares to explode
Explode — dmg equal to its stored Steam Eruption amount, then dies
Waterfall Giant.pattern: Uses Pressurize on its first turn, then repeats a fixed cycle: Stomp -> Ram -> Siphon -> Pressure Gun -> Pressure Up -> back to Stomp. Death sequence: when reduced to 0 HP while it has Steam Eruption, it does not die — it becomes invulnerable and uses About To Blow, which removes all of its buffs and debuffs; on the following turn it uses Explode, dealing damage equal to its accumulated Steam Eruption, then dies. If it is killed while it has no Steam Eruption, it dies normally with no explosion. Damage that also applies a debuff can trigger About To Blow's cleanse first, with the debuff applied afterward.

moves: Beckon — shuffles 2 Beckon status cards into your deck (1 into draw pile, 1 into discard pile). Beckon costs 1 and is unupgradable: at the end of your turn, if it is in your hand, you lose 6 HP (HP loss, ignores Block), and it then discards itself
Gaze — 7 dmg, shuffles 1 Beckon into your discard pile
a9_moves: Beckon — shuffles 2 Beckon status cards into your deck (1 into draw pile, 1 into discard pile). Beckon costs 1 and is unupgradable: at the end of your turn, if it is in your hand, you lose 6 HP (HP loss, ignores Block), and it then discards itself
Gaze — 8 dmg, shuffles 1 Beckon into your discard pile
Soul Fysh.pattern: Repeats the same five moves in a fixed order with no variation: Beckon -> De-Gas -> Gaze -> Fade -> Scream, then loops. The first stack of Intangible from Fade expires during the turn transition, so Fade effectively yields only 1 turn of Intangible per cycle rather than 2.

powers: Plating 12 — At the end of your turn, gain X Block. Plating is reduced by 1 at the start of your turn.
Asleep 3 — Awakens upon losing HP or after X turns.
moves: Soul Siphon — removes 2 Strength and 2 Dexterity from the player, gains 2 Strength
a9_moves: Soul Siphon — removes 2 Strength and 2 Dexterity from the player, gains 2 Strength
Lagavulin Matriarch.pattern: Starts Asleep with 12 Plating, using Sleep (does nothing) while asleep. It wakes after 3 turns or as soon as it takes unblocked damage, whichever comes first; on waking it loses its Plating. After waking it repeats a fixed cycle with no variation: Slash -> Disembowel -> Slash2 -> Soul Siphon, then loops.
